reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal 30mL
reviews.text: "I’ve read so many great reviews about this serum in a lot of places. I just started using it—only twice so far—so I can't really tell yet, but I have a feeling it’s going to be good. I have really dark circles under my eyes and I truly hope this helps ❤️ Just make sure to use it correctly because it contains retinal; definitely read the instructions!"
reviews.zh: 我喺好多地方睇過好多關於呢支精華嘅好評。我啱啱開始用，到目前為止只係用過兩次，所以暫時都唔知得唔得，但我有種感覺會work。我眼下有勁深嘅黑眼圈，真心希望呢支可以幫到手 ❤️ 記得一定要用得啱，因為佢含有視黃醛；一定要睇清楚使用說明！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal 30mL
reviews.text: This is one of the BEST of the BEST eye serum I have tried so far. I have used so many different brand including all those well known name brand like (La Mer, Estée Lauder, etc) as well as many Korean and Japanese brand ( all the big brands) non of them will give me such great result! Just turn 40 and stay in sunny dry L.A. I need something helps my under eye fine lines and some milia caused by heavy eye cream (those name brand eye cream 😭). This eye serum did the job RIGHT! 1 big milia is gone after 2 weeks using this! OMG that’s magic! Other milia have became less visible (I also use this with Differin adapalene gel .01% for the milia) no irritation at all! My under eyes are more pumped and wrinkles are less visible. I m hoping to see my dark circles get lighter after continuing using this
reviews.zh: 呢支係我用過最最好嘅眼部精華之一。我用過好多唔同品牌，包括所有大牌子好似（La Mer、Estée Lauder 等），仲有好多韓國同日本品牌（所有大牌子），冇一隻可以畀到咁好嘅效果！啱啱40歲，住喺陽光充沛又乾嘅洛杉磯。我需要一啲嘢幫我處理眼底細紋同因為厚重眼霜引起嘅一啲油脂粒（嗰啲名牌眼霜 😭）。呢支眼部精華做到嘢！用咗 2 星期之後 1 粒大油脂粒走咗！OMG 簡直係魔法！其他油脂粒都冇咁明顯（我同時用 Differin 0.1% 阿達帕林 gel 處理油脂粒）完全冇刺激！眼底更加飽滿，皺紋都冇咁明顯。希望繼續用可以睇到黑眼圈淡啲

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal 30mL
reviews.text: Love the pump applicator on this eye cream, first impression. It’s super light weight on the skin, I have dry under eyes and this product is super moisturizing. I love the feeling it gives. Someone once said they would use it all over the face so I would also apply some on my forehead for those ginseng benefits. I even repurchased another one to give to my mom
reviews.zh: 第一印象好鍾意呢支眼霜嘅泵裝設計。搽喺皮膚上超輕，我眼底偏乾，呢支產品超保濕。我好鍾意佢畀我嘅感覺。有人曾經講過會用佢搽全臉，所以我都會搽少少喺額頭度攞人參嘅好處。我仲額外買多一支畀我媽媽

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal 30mL
reviews.text: I have used this eye cream for about a month day and night and I have to say that this really works! I had been using the inkey list retinol eye cream before this and it didn’t do anything, the first picture was taken may 3rd and the second one was taken may 26th so it’s not even a full month and there’s a difference. I used to use a lot of color correction and concealer for my dark circles but now I can go without color correction and just use one thin layer of concealer. I have also noticed my fine lines under my eyes start to settle down. I don’t expect my fine lines to disappear a completely but I deff think they won’t be as noticeable if I keep using this eye cream which I deff will! I have also been drinking more water.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢支眼霜日頭夜晚大概一個月，我要講呢支真係work！之前用 inkey list 嘅 retinol 眼霜，完全冇效果。第一張相係 5 月 3 號影，第二張係 5 月 26 號，所以未夠成個月就已經有分別。以前我要用好多調色霜同遮瑕膏去遮黑眼圈，而家可以唔用調色霜，只係搽一層薄薄嘅遮瑕膏。我仲留意到眼底細紋開始減淡。我唔期望細紋會完全消失，但我真係覺得如果繼續用呢支眼霜（我一定會）就唔會咁明顯！我亦有飲多咗水。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal 30mL
reviews.text: Быстро впитывается, и приятная на ощупь. Но после кожа вокруг глаз становиться очень чувствительная и мелкие морщинки становиться заметными и придает несколько лет к возрасту. Когда перестала наносить этот крем кожа вокруг глаз стало лучше. Не оправдал ожидание)
reviews.zh: 吸收得好快，觸感都舒服。但用完之後眼周皮膚變得好敏感，細紋變得明顯，睇落老咗幾歲。停用之後眼周皮膚反而好返。冇達到預期)

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal 30mL
reviews.text:
Idioma: Español. Languaje : Spanish. 

Tengo poco tiempo usando este producto, sin embargo he notado ciertos aspectos que no me encantan. 

Es un poco irritable, si la aplico cerca de las comisuras de mis ojos me causa enrojecimiento y comezón. 
Considero que tiene buena humectación pero por los problemas de la irritación la uso MÁXIMO 3 veces por semana.

Tiene un color ligeramente amarillento y no contienen ningún tipo de fragancia. 

Al abrir el empaque tuve que pulsar muchas veces para que saliera el producto por lo que me dio la sensación de que la botella tenia demasiado aire y poco producto. 
Recibí mi paquete el 9 de enero por lo que lo he usado un aproximado de 13 veces con una gota del producto y el envase parece haber sido usado mucho mas.
reviews.zh:
語言：西班牙文。Languaje：Spanish。

我用呢個產品嘅時間唔長，但已經留意到一啲我唔太鍾意嘅地方。

有少少刺激性，如果搽近眼尾會令我泛紅同痕癢。
我覺得保濕唔錯，但因為刺激嘅問題，我一個禮拜最多用 3 次。

顏色帶少少黃，亦冇任何香料。

一打開包裝就要撳好多次先出到產品，所以俾我嘅感覺係支樽入面太多空氣太少產品。
我 1 月 9 號收件，所以大概用咗 13 次，每次一滴，但支樽好似已經用咗好多。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal 30mL
reviews.text:
I didn't like this product for my eyes. I like the ingredients, but it feels too heavy on the eyes.
So I use this cream on my face and neck. Since it contains retinal, it should work well against wrinkles and acne in the long run.
The consistency is thick and the color is yellowish due to the retinal. But after application, the cream is absorbed quickly enough, and the yellow color disappears on the face.
I recommend this product for the face, but personally for my eyes it didn't fit. I'd prefer something lightweight on the eyes.
reviews.zh:
我唔鍾意呢個產品用喺眼。我鍾意佢嘅成份，但搽喺眼上面感覺太厚。
所以我會用呢支霜搽面同頸。因為佢含有視黃醛，長遠嚟講應該可以對抗皺紋同暗瘡。
質地比較杰，因為視黃醛嘅關係顏色帶黃。但搽完之後，吸收得幾快，搽上面之後黃色就唔見。
我推薦呢個產品用喺面上，但對我嚟講就唔啱用喺眼。我比較想用輕盈嘅眼霜。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal 30mL
reviews.text: I really love beauty of joseon products as they use natural ingredients in their skin care product lines and are extra value-for-money! My eye area is rather sensitive and some eye products products will cause my eye lids to feel heavy and tired after a short while. This eye cream is light weight and easy to apply and it does not feel heavy on my eyes. It absorbs quickly and doesn't feel sticky. I feel that my eye bags have improved.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 Beauty of Joseon 嘅產品，因為佢哋嘅護膚品用天然成份，而且性價比超高！我眼周比較敏感，有啲眼部產品用一陣眼瞼就會覺得攰同重。呢支眼霜質地輕，容易搽，搽喺眼上唔覺得重。吸收得快，唔會黐笠笠。我feel到眼袋有改善。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
